baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative بِأَييِّكُم distributes ٱلْمَفْتُونُ across the addressed parties rather than presupposing which party bears it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The trial branch makes the predicate an assayed status: exposure tests competing parties and distinguishes what each is made of.

activation_trace.role: Assaying by trial supplies a discriminating test whose bearer is left open by the interrogative.

changed_reading.after: Which party is the one being assayed, so that its real quality will be disclosed?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْمَفْتُونُ can name a subject marked by what the root process has done to it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fire branch converts an abstract diagnosis into a material after-state: one side emerges burned, darkened, or altered by exposure.

activation_trace.role: Fiery alteration supplies a visible after-effect for the marked nominal.

changed_reading.before: The predicate reports a hidden mental defect.
changed_reading.after: The predicate asks which side has been visibly transformed or blackened by what it underwent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same marked nominal can attach to loss of direction rather than loss of cognition.
baseline_models.mechanism: A party is maftun insofar as it has been bent away from a sound course; the question contests orientation, not merely sanity.

activation_trace.role: Diversion from the right course turns the predicate into a diagnosis of misorientation.

changed_reading.after: Which party has actually been deflected from the right course?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْمَفْتُونُ can denote the one placed inside an ordeal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hardship and ease can both function as testing conditions, so the bearer need not look damaged when the question is asked.

activation_trace.role: Ordeal and affliction supply a condition that can include both adversity and apparent ease.

changed_reading.before: The maftun is already manifestly ruined.
changed_reading.after: Which of you is presently inside the ordeal, even if prosperity conceals that fact?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular predicate can locate a party within a collective field of conflict.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fitna is not only an interior state; it can be killing, factional fracture, or the social process that makes a group turn against itself.

activation_trace.role: War and social discord relocate the predicate from private psychology to collective fracture.

changed_reading.before: Which individual has a private defect?
changed_reading.after: Which side is caught in, or functioning as the locus of, destructive social discord?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventory joins loss of reason and loss of property under the same root branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative can suspend two diagnoses at once: one party may lose cognitive command, material possession, or both.

activation_trace.role: Loss of mind or property broadens the marked condition beyond conventional madness.

changed_reading.before: The question can only be about insanity.
changed_reading.after: Which party is the one whose reason, property, or governing command has gone?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The distributive question between parties can host the root branch in which life has two contrasting modes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The maftun becomes the location of a bitter-sweet or adverse-favorable polarity, with the question asking where each party stands within it.

activation_trace.role: Life in two modes supplies a reversible polarity for the interrogative distribution.

changed_reading.before: The verse fixes one stable defective identity.
changed_reading.after: Which side occupies which of life's two conditions, and can their apparent positions reverse?

context_deltas.mechanism: Future mutual sight announces a verdict, explicit testing makes hidden condition appear, and later uncovering removes concealment. Together they make 68:6 the announcement of an assay whose result unfolds in public stages.

activation_trace.role: The assay branch supplies the test whose result the context progressively manifests.
Mutual visual perception supplies the promised public observation of the result.
Testing that reveals condition provides an enacted analogue of the focus assay.
Exposure of a previously hidden defect supplies the terminal disclosure stage.

structural_cues: 68:5 places reciprocal future seeing immediately before the focus question.
68:16 adds a future marking action from branchless و س م; it is used only as a visible-result cue.
The sequence moves from promised sight to narrated testing and eventual exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeing, condition-revealing trial, a future mark, and exposure; I infer a single assay-to-verdict arrow across them. Alternatively, these may be separate scenes linked only by the broad theme of disclosure.

changed_reading.after: Which party proves defective under an assay whose verdict is successively seen, marked, narrated, and uncovered?

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing opens the discourse, while the later cross-examination asks for a book, a studied record, a guarantor, and enacted truth. The assay therefore tests claims by inspectable evidence rather than by reciprocal name-calling.

activation_trace.role: Assaying supplies the adjudicative test applied to competing claims.
The prepared writing instrument supplies a means of fixing evidence.
Ordered written lines supply an inspectable record rather than an unsupported label.
Binding inscription supplies the demanded warrant for a judgment.
Following a text through reading supplies the verification procedure.
Assertion without certainty supplies the weak claim being put under assay.
Truth realized in action supplies the standard by which the claim survives or fails.

structural_cues: 68:1 opens with writing before any accusation is evaluated.
68:36-41 forms a run of evidentiary questions; branchless ك ي ف at 68:36 is used only as part of that interrogative structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies records, textual study, uncertain assertion, and truth enacted; I infer that 68:6 heads an evidentiary hearing that assays the rival diagnoses. Alternatively, the writing frame and later questions may support authority generally without forming one procedural chain.

changed_reading.before: The two sides exchange incompatible diagnoses.
changed_reading.after: Which diagnosis survives a record-based assay, and which is exposed as an unsupported claim?

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth and lineage create apparent security, but the garden episode explicitly names testing; the plan to block entry exposes possession as the testing medium, and deprivation reveals its result.

activation_trace.role: The ordeal branch allows prosperity itself to be the testing condition.
Accumulated property supplies the apparently favorable material of the ordeal.
Lineage and offspring supply social extension that can conceal vulnerability.
A trial that makes condition appear identifies the garden as an assay rather than mere background.
Literal entry supplies the gate whose planned denial reveals the owners' disposition.
Failure to obtain what was possessed supplies the disclosed outcome of the prosperity test.

structural_cues: 68:14 foregrounds wealth and sons before the garden owners are tested.
68:24 grammatically negates entry for the poor person, making exclusion the owners' revealing act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prosperity, explicit trial, blocked entry, and deprivation; I infer that possession causes no failure by itself but furnishes the condition in which exclusion reveals the bearer. Alternatively, the wealth portrait and garden story may target different parties without direct identification.

changed_reading.before: The maftun is the obvious victim of hardship.
changed_reading.after: The maftun may be the prosperous possessor already under ordeal, exposed only when abundance is used to exclude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners move from seeing to naming themselves lost, then deprived, then hoping for a substitute. This activates the property-loss half of the focus branch without canceling its mental-loss half.

activation_trace.role: The joined loss of mind or property keeps both diagnostic paths live.
Loss of a thing turns the owners' self-diagnosis into recognition of vanished possession.
Deprivation supplies the concrete property condition under the focus loss branch.
One thing standing in place of another confirms that the missing object is material and replaceable.

structural_cues: 68:26-27 changes the owners' reading of their own condition from mislocation to deprivation.
68:32 preserves hope for replacement, so loss is not reduced to mental confusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies object-loss, deprivation, and substitution; I infer that these realize the property side of the focus branch. Alternatively, their self-description may remain figurative moral error while property loss is only narrative circumstance.

changed_reading.before: Loss in ٱلْمَفْتُونُ means loss of reason alone.
changed_reading.after: The garden sequence lets ٱلْمَفْتُونُ ask which party will lose its possessions and thereby have its governing judgment exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse first denies a covering of reason, then ends with opponents trying to dislodge the addressee after hearing and attributing that same diagnosis to him. The focus question rebounds the label onto the diagnostic conduct of the accusers.

activation_trace.role: Loss of reason supplies the contested diagnosis whose true bearer remains open.
Concealment of intellect supplies the diagnosis explicitly denied at the opening.
Loss of stable footing supplies the opponents' attempted destabilization before they diagnose another.
Understanding and compliance supply the response that hearing could enable but their conduct blocks.
Attributing what is not established supplies the mechanism of a projected diagnosis.
The repeated covering-of-intellect label closes the frame around the focus question.

structural_cues: 68:2 denies the diagnosis before 68:6, while 68:51 reports it in the opponents' speech.
In 68:51 the attempted dislodgment follows hearing and precedes the accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, hearing, attempted dislodgment, and attribution; I infer that failed understanding and destabilizing conduct reverse the accusation toward its speakers. Alternatively, the closing verse may only quote their charge without making their conduct a counter-diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: 68:6 asks which side deserves the label asserted in the final accusation.
changed_reading.after: 68:6 asks whose judgment is actually covered or destabilized: the accused, or those who hear, try to dislodge him, and then project the label.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gradual taking, extended time, concealed strategy, and delay within a race make the focus condition temporal. The bearer can look stable while the assay advances by increments toward disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Assaying supplies a process whose result need not be immediate.
Taking by successive degrees supplies the assay's incremental motion.
Extension of time supplies the interval in which a false appearance of safety persists.
Concealed strategy supplies the directional pressure behind the apparently passive delay.
Delay within a race supplies an image of deferred but structured resolution.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 explicitly pairs gradual movement with granted time.
The focus question gives no immediate answer, which leaves room for a processual verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies graduated taking, time extension, strategy, and race-delay; I infer an arrow from apparent respite to eventual assay-result. Alternatively, these roots may describe punishment timing without revising the semantics of ٱلْمَفْتُونُ.

changed_reading.before: The maftun is an immediately recognizable type.
changed_reading.after: The maftun may be the party being exposed degree by degree while delay itself disguises the active assay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech presses and injures, is carried from person to person, exits as disclosure, crosses boundaries like contagion, and returns as mutual blame. This gives the discord branch a circulating social mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Social fracture supplies the collective condition generated by circulating harmful speech.
Injury to others through speech supplies the initiating pressure.
Walking with reports supplies the carrier movement between people.
Speech escaping as betrayal supplies the transferred content.
Transfer like contagion supplies an exploratory model for how discord propagates across a group.
Reciprocal reproach supplies the returning loop in which the group turns its speech on itself.

structural_cues: 68:11 compresses injurer, carrier, and transmitted report into one sequence.
68:30 changes the direction of speech from outward exclusion to inward mutual blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal injury, movement, betrayal, a transfer branch, and reciprocal reproach; I infer a causal circulation from speech to group fracture. The contagion arrow is analogical, and alternatively the boundary-crossing root may retain only ordinary transgression here.

changed_reading.before: Fitna is a private mental condition located in one person.
changed_reading.after: The maftun can be the side whose speech system carries injury outward until discord returns as mutual blame.

context_deltas.mechanism: Replacement keeps state-change possible, while punishment and well-being are set beside a question that refuses to make the sound and the culpable equivalent. The rare two-mode branch becomes a judicial polarity rather than a vague alternation of fortune.

activation_trace.role: Life in two conditions supplies the baseline polarity distributed across the parties.
Substitution supplies movement from one lived condition into another.
Painful consequence supplies the adverse pole.
Favorable condition and well-being supply the contrasting pole.
Assigning something to a state supplies the proposed equivalence that the question rejects.
Freedom from defect supplies one class within the polarity.
Culpable offense supplies the non-equivalent opposing class.

structural_cues: 68:33-35 places two outcomes and two human classes in explicit contrast.
68:32 allows transition by replacement without erasing the distinction between states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, adverse and favorable outcomes, and a rejected equivalence; I infer that these specify the focus branch's two life-modes as morally differentiated states. Alternatively, the rare focus branch may be only a lexical echo with no role in the later contrast.

changed_reading.before: The two-state branch suggests only fluctuating sweet and bitter fortune.
changed_reading.after: 68:6 opens a reversible but non-equivalent bifurcation: parties can change condition, yet soundness and culpability are not made the same.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inner disposition is contrasted with oiling and social smoothing; later covering and uncovering extend the material contrast. An assay reveals composition, whereas coating can temporarily make a surface smooth and hide what the test would disclose.

activation_trace.role: Material assaying supplies the test of intrinsic quality beneath appearance.
Inner disposition supplies the durable quality that a surface treatment cannot create.
Applied oil supplies the literal coating side of the material analogy.
Soft social accommodation supplies the behavioral function of that coating.
Removal of a cover supplies the moment when the treated surface can no longer hide condition.
Covering supplies the opposing operation that delays disclosure.

structural_cues: 68:4 names inward character before 68:9 stages reciprocal smoothing.
The later sequence moves from covering to a scene of exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inner disposition, literal oil, conciliatory smoothing, covering, and uncovering; I infer a material arrow in which coating masks but assay reveals. Alternatively, the oil and assay domains may remain independent metaphors, so this reading should stay exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The assay merely separates two verbal claims.
changed_reading.after: The assay asks which party has intrinsic integrity once cosmetic or conciliatory coating is stripped away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch is a concrete cover associated with riding equipment, not a normal rendering of the verse. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in ٱلْمَفْتُونُ and reinforced by context branches for concealed reason, covering, exposure, and open ground. Downstream prose should call it a cover/uncover activation, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The concrete covering branch of the sole focus root provides the anchor.

activation_trace.role: A concrete protective covering supplies the outlier's material anchor.
Concealment supplies a cognitive covering adjacent to the focus question.
Lifting a cover supplies the reversal that makes hidden status visible.
Unscreened open space supplies the exposed endpoint of the covering sequence.
Covering supplies the final opposing action against disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The concrete cover branch is irrelevant noise.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, 68:6 can ask which side is under or supplying a cover in a discourse that repeatedly conceals and then strips concealment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the garden passage does not explicitly identify fire as the cause. It remains anchored in the focus root's burning-and-darkening branch, while the passing event, ruined condition, and punishment provide an aftermath sequence. Downstream prose should describe a scorched-result analogy and preserve uncertainty about the physical cause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The burning and darkening branch of ٱلْمَفْتُونُ anchors a visibly altered aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Burning and dark alteration supply the material result being tested against the garden sequence.
A passing event supplies the unseen intervention that precedes the altered state.
A calamitous ruined condition supplies the visible aftermath without fixing its cause.
Painful punishment supplies the broader consequence frame for the material alteration.

changed_reading.before: The fire branch would require an explicit burning scene and should be discarded.
changed_reading.after: The focus can carry a contained image of the party that emerges darkened or materially altered after an unseen ordeal, as the garden does overnight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of ل و م to a branch involving a touch or edge of madness, distant from ordinary mutual blame. It remains anchored in the focus loss-of-reason branch and in the owners' post-loss reciprocal reproach. Downstream prose should identify it explicitly as a split-root echo, not as the direct meaning of their verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch joins loss of reason and property, allowing the garden group's material loss to approach a collective cognitive edge.

activation_trace.role: Joined mental and material loss supplies the focus anchor for the collective reversal.
Object-loss supplies the event that destabilizes the group's prior certainty.
The non-dominant branch's brush with madness supplies an exploratory echo within reciprocal blame.

changed_reading.before: The question seeks one isolated mad individual.
changed_reading.after: After shared property loss, a whole group can approach the edge of the focus condition through mutually circulating blame.

strongest_changes: The static madness label became an assay whose verdict is manifested through seeing, testing, marking, and exposure.
The ordeal reading moved upstream into prosperity: wealth can be the testing medium before deprivation makes the result visible.
The loss branch split productively into loss of reason and loss of property, with the garden sequence strongly activating the latter.
The accusation became reversible: hearing followed by attempted dislodgment and attribution can diagnose the accusers as well as the accused.
summary.what_was_special: A single marked predicate sustained material, cognitive, economic, social, evidentiary, and temporal mechanisms at once. The context repeatedly staged revelation of condition without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus construction leaves the exact relation between bearer, cause, and locus of the condition underdetermined.
The covering, blackened-aftermath, two-state, contagion, and non-dominant blame activations are deliberately analogical or branch-distant.
Several context sequences may be thematic parallels rather than causal continuations of the focus question.
